title: Statistics Toolkit
prompt: Implement `double mean(const int* a, int n)` (sum divided by n as a double), `int count_above(const int* a, int n, int t)` (elements strictly greater than t), and `int mode(const int* a, int n)` (the value occurring most often; if several tie, return the SMALLEST such value).

tests.name: mode tie
tests.hint: Tie between 4 and 2 — return the smaller.
